sets.title: Patient-reported chemotherapy symptoms (FLAT → TakeCare XML)
sets.description: openEHR FLAT composition from a patient symptom questionnaire, mapped to TakeCare ProfdocHISMessage XML using Blockly XML blocks. Select Go Template output mode to see generated Go text/template code. Reference hand-authored Go template scripts are in the mapping/ folder. Parameters come from the Defaults Map.
